title: Housing Now Lands Portfolio
description: Opportunity to lease a land portfolio comprising two urban development sites, offered individually or as a portfolio.

citations.excerpt: opportunity to lease a land portfolio (the “Offering”) comprising two urban development sites

two urban development sites located at 2444 Eglinton Avenue East (“2444 Eglinton”) in Scarborough and 5207 Dundas Street West, Block 1 of the Bloor-Kipling (Six Points) lands (“5207 Dundas”) in Etobicoke.
The Offering is being marketed to interested parties through a two round offering process.
